result.instructions: Tools for Findymail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the work email for Jane Smith at acme.com."; "Verify these three email addresses before I import them."; "How many finder credits do we have left this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Findymail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run findymail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run findymail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run findymail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. findymail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: findymail_get_credits
tools.title: Get remaining credits
tools.description: Get the remaining credit balance of the team. Use type 'finder' (default) or 'verifier'. On usage-based plans the response has has_capacity instead of credits. Findymail API: GET /api/credits.

tools.name: findymail_get_usage
tools.title: Get credit usage
tools.description: Get daily or monthly credit usage (finder and verifier) for the account over a date range. Defaults to the last 30 days. Findymail API: GET /api/credits/report/summary.

from.description: Start date, inclusive (yyyy-mm-dd). Default: 30 days ago.

tools.name: findymail_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the contact lists the account owns or can see (with id, name, and sharing flags). Use the id with findymail_list_contacts. Findymail API: GET /api/lists.

tools.name: findymail_list_contacts
tools.title: List saved contacts
tools.description: List the contacts saved in one contact list (name, email, LinkedIn URL, company, job title). Use list_id 0 (default) for all saved contacts. Findymail API: GET /api/contacts/get/{id}.

list_id.description: Contact list id from findymail_list_contact_lists. 0 = all contacts (default).

tools.name: findymail_list_exclusion_lists
tools.title: List exclusion lists
tools.description: List the exclusion lists the account owns or shares with its team. An exclusion list holds domains that Intellimatch searches skip. Findymail API: GET /api/intellimatch/exclusion-lists.

tools.name: findymail_list_excluded_domains
tools.title: List excluded domains
tools.description: List the excluded domains of the global exclusion list, or of one list when list_id is set. Supports a text query and pagination. Findymail API: GET /api/intellimatch/domains.

list_id.description: Only domains from this exclusion list id.

tools.name: findymail_list_signal_monitors
tools.title: List signal monitors
tools.description: List the signal monitors (keyword, new-hire, job-change, and post-engagement watches) with their match counts. Findymail API: GET /api/signals/monitors.

ownership.description: Which monitors to list (default: all visible).

tools.name: findymail_list_signals
tools.title: List intent signals
tools.description: List detected signals (keyword mentions, new hires, job changes, post engagements) with contact and company data. Filter by type, monitor, date range, or relevance score. Findymail API: GET /api/signals.

monitor_id.description: Only signals from this monitor id.

date_from.description: Detected on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: Detected on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

relevance_scores.description: Comma-separated AI relevance scores to keep, 0 to 5 (for example 4,5).

tools.name: findymail_get_signal
tools.title: Get an intent signal
tools.description: Get one signal by id, with its contact, company, and the monitors that matched it. Findymail API: GET /api/signals/{id}.

tools.name: findymail_get_intellimatch_status
tools.title: Get Intellimatch search status
tools.description: Check whether an Intellimatch search (from findymail_search_leads) is done. Status is one of success, processing, pending, failed, or not_found. Free. Findymail API: GET /api/intellimatch/status.

tools.name: findymail_get_intellimatch_results
tools.title: Get Intellimatch search results
tools.description: Read one page of companies and contacts from a finished Intellimatch search. Call findymail_get_intellimatch_status first and wait for success. Free. Findymail API: GET /api/intellimatch/data.

tools.name: findymail_find_email_by_name
tools.title: Find an email from a name
tools.description: Find a work email for a person from their full name and the company domain. Spends credits when it finds a result. Findymail API: POST /api/search/name.

annotations.title: Find an email from a name

tools.name: findymail_verify_email
tools.title: Verify an email address
tools.description: Check whether an email address is valid and deliverable. Spends one verifier credit per check, whatever the result. Findymail API: POST /api/verify.

tools.name: findymail_find_phone
tools.title: Find a phone number
tools.description: Find a phone number for a person from their LinkedIn business profile URL. Costs 10 finder credits when a number is found. EU citizens get no result. Findymail API: POST /api/search/phone.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the person.

tools.name: findymail_find_employees
tools.title: Find employees at a company
tools.description: Find people with given job titles at a company website. Returns names and LinkedIn URLs, not emails. Costs 1 finder credit per employee returned. Findymail API: POST /api/search/employees.

job_titles.description: Job titles to match, for example ['CFO'].

count.description: Maximum number of people to return.

tools.name: findymail_get_company
tools.title: Get company information
tools.description: Look up a company by LinkedIn company URL, domain, or name. Give at least one. Costs 1 finder credit when the company is found. Findymail API: POST /api/search/company.

tools.name: findymail_reverse_email_lookup
tools.title: Find a business profile from an email
tools.description: Find the business profile behind an email address (work or personal). Costs 1 finder credit when a profile is found, and 1 more when with_profile is true and data is returned. Findymail API: POST /api/search/reverse-email.

email.description: The email address to look up.

with_profile.description: Also return the full profile data (costs 1 more credit).

annotations.title: Find a business profile from an email

tools.name: findymail_search_leads
tools.title: Start an Intellimatch lead search
tools.description: Start a plain-language company and contact search. Returns a hash at once. Then poll findymail_get_intellimatch_status and read findymail_get_intellimatch_results. Credits are charged by the search itself. Findymail API: POST /api/intellimatch/search.

query.description: Plain-language search, for example 'SaaS companies in the US with 50 to 200 staff'.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

find_contact.description: Also find a contact person per company.

find_email.description: Also find an email for each contact.

find_phone.description: Also find a phone number for each contact.

require_email.description: Keep only results that have an email.

lead_list_id.description: Save results to this contact list id.

exclusion_list_id.description: Skip domains in this exclusion list.

tools.name: findymail_create_contact_list
tools.title: Create a contact list
tools.description: Create a new, empty contact list to store saved contacts. Findymail API: POST /api/lists.

name.description: Name of the new contact list.

tools.name: findymail_add_excluded_domains
tools.title: Add excluded domains
tools.description: Add domains to the global exclusion list, or to one exclusion list when list_id is set, so Intellimatch searches skip them. Adding the same domain again does no harm. Findymail API: POST /api/intellimatch/domains.

list_id.description: Exclusion list id. Omit for the global list.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Findymail
prompts.description: What you can do with Findymail here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_work_email_from_a_name
prompts.title: Find a work email from a name
prompts.description: Check the finder credits first. Then give a full name and a company domain to find a work email, which spends credits when found.

prompts.name: verify_addresses_before_an_import
prompts.title: Verify addresses before an import
prompts.description: Check each email address for validity and deliverability. Every check spends one verifier credit, whatever the result.

prompts.name: run_a_lead_search_in_plain_language
prompts.title: Run a lead search in plain language
prompts.description: Describe the companies and people you want. Then poll the search status and read the results page by page.

prompts.name: track_credit_use_for_the_month
prompts.title: Track credit use for the month
prompts.description: Read the remaining finder or verifier credits. Then read the daily or monthly usage over a date range.

prompts.name: review_intent_signals_from_your_monitors
prompts.title: Review intent signals from your monitors
prompts.description: List the keyword, new-hire and job-change monitors with their match counts. Read the signals they found, with the contact and company.
